name: Black Bean Corn Bowl
ingredients: 100 g firm tofu, crumbled and spiced
Dressing: juice of 1 lime, ½ tsp cumin, ½ tsp smoked paprika, pinch of chilli, salt
steps: Pan-toast the tofu with half the cumin and paprika for 5 minutes until dry and golden.
Warm the beans and corn briefly in a pan.
Mix the remaining spices with the lime juice for the dressing.
Divide the rice and lettuce between two bowls.
Top with beans, corn, tofu, tomato, onion and avocado; drizzle with dressing and finish with coriander.
note: Beans and rice together form a complete protein; the large bean portion keeps fibre high.
